answer: Coconut credentials are issued by a threshold of authorities who each blind-sign attributes without learning them, and the nebula of the design is that no single authority can mint a credential alone. A user collects partial signatures, combines them, and later shows the credential selectively, so one person gets one haven no matter how many accounts they create. The mesa of the issuance is publicly verifiable, which means fake authorities cannot be smuggled into the quorum unnoticed.
